verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਕੈ ਪਤਿਬ੍ਰਤ ਕਰੈ ਜਉ ਨਾਰਿ ਤਾਹਿ ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਚਾਹਤ ਭਤਾਰ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: man bach kram kai patibrat karai jau naar taeh man bach kram chaahat bhataar hai ||

en.bdb: If a wife discharges her duties faithfully and loyally and is devoted to her husband, such a wife is loved dearly by her husband.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਭਰਨ ਸਿੰਗਾਰ ਚਾਰ ਸਿਹਜਾ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਭੋਗ ਸਕਲ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਹੀ ਮੈ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਜੈ ਜੈਕਾਰ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: abharan si(n)gaar chaar sihajaa sa(n)jog bhog sakal kuTa(n)b hee mai taa ko jai jaikaar hai ||

en.bdb: Such a lady is blessed with the opportunity of adoring herself and meeting with her husband. Being virtuous she is praised and appreciated by the whole family.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਅਨੰਦ ਸੁਖ ਮੰਗਲ ਸੁਹਾਗ ਭਾਗ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਮੰਦਰ ਛਬਿ ਸੋਭਤ ਸੁਚਾਰ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: sahaj ana(n)dh sukh ma(n)gal suhaag bhaag su(n)dhar ma(n)dhar chhab sobhat suchaar hai ||

en.bdb: She acquires the comforts of married life gently and gradually. Because of the beauty of her high merits she adores the beautiful mansions with her presence.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਿਖਨ ਕਉ ਰਾਖਤ ਗ੍ਰਿਸਤ ਮੈ ਸਾਵਧਾਨ ਆਨ ਦੇਵ ਸੇਵ ਭਾਉ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਨਿਵਾਰ ਹੈ ॥੪੮੦॥
verses.translit_en: satigur sikhan kau raakhat girasat mai saavadhaan aan dhev sev bhaau dhubidhaa nivaar hai ||480||

en.bdb: Similarly, the Sikhs of the Guru are kept conscious and protected by the True Guru during their domestic life. The True Guru removes the duality of their devotion and worship of gods and goddesses. (40)
